# ChatPlex compatibility providers

Native-boundary sources derive from the MIT-licensed ChatPlexSDK-BS checkout at signed commit 73d16a6, based on the maintained 1.46.0 implementation. Shared providers preserve SDK namespaces and APIs while selecting real target-native signatures. The consumer retains unrelated implementation files; these six original source files are excluded only when the provider flag is enabled. Source includes current request ownership, submission and asynchronous menu initialization behavior. Compilation and asset review are in progress.
